scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --local
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.check: npm run types && npx tsc && npm run build && npm run check:assets && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run && wrangler check startup --env staging
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test:legacy && npm run test:worker
